title: Ada Research — Void Tower System Atlas
thesis: Technology is trapped in convention, yet in essence a potential general queer intellect. Ada Research starts as Nature-of-Code tutorials in VR and deliberately lets text, artifacts, machines, body, and space drift apart to form new queer relations inside an unfinished 210-floor skyscraper.

orders.title: 01 · Cumulative Concept Order
orders.subtitle: The Nature of Code spine — what formal, visual, and kinematic rules are permitted yet
orders.rule: Never spoil later chapters early: Monochrome before Color (F28), linear lerp before WaveFunctions (F62), static architecture before transforming space (F13 -> F14).

orders.title: 02 · Desiring-Machine & Capability Order
orders.subtitle: Deleuze & Guattari partial objects, prefabs, robots, and player powers unlocking downward
orders.rule: Machines do not sit alone: each factory, robot, loom, or package releases partial objects or capabilities into Model B's kit that plug unexpectedly into later floors.

orders.title: 03 · Editorial & Witness Order
orders.subtitle: Model B's living void.md book, Ghost Student vertical lessons, and frozen reading editions
orders.rule: The reading route can leap, loop, or detour across floors without breaking the skyscraper. Every poetic song breadcrumb pairs with an easy-to-understand plain breadcrumb.

layers.title: Tutorial & Critical Ground
layers.question: What formal mechanism is taught, and where do its conventions leak?
layers.description: The original Nature-of-Code foundation (`tutorial.md`) paired with critical and historical inquiry (`final.md`, `critical.md`). Drift between text and room is deliberate and tracked.

layers.title: Care Unit Model B (Camera · Breadcrumbs · void.md)
layers.question: What does Model B photograph, sing, and write into the living Void book?
layers.description: Model B is the protagonist co-authoring with Palle and AI models: camcorder HUD receipts, poetic Inner Opera song breadcrumbs paired with plain-language handles, and the growing `void.md` manuscript.

layers.title: The Void Tower Architecture
layers.question: How does the unfinished skyscraper hold this floor, its shafts, and vertical leaks?
layers.description: 210 stacked concrete and scaffold floors linked by Shaft A, Shaft B, structural columns, work lights, and open weather so floors visibly bleed into one another.

layers.title: Desiring-Machines, Robots & Prefabs
layers.question: Which robot, factory, or assemblage wakes up here, and what partial object travels forward?
layers.description: 291 authored prefabs plus factories, looms, vending rigs, catalysts, and robots that organize fragments of the ontology and couple into downstream floors.

layers.title: Queer Ontology & QFEP Underneath
layers.question: How does code or space refuse false neutrality, expose norms, or activate queer desire?
layers.description: Operational queer intellect in code and world: denaturalizing standardized codes, re-coupling partial objects across incompatible systems, holding bodily remainder and Gödelian outsides.

layers.title: Body, Costume, Stickers & Care
layers.question: How is Model B's body clothed, marked, fatigued, cared for, or transformed here?
layers.description: Model B's mutable queer surface — knit shell, tailored suit, super-drag outfit, badge tee, surface stickers, BodyCharge fatigue/recovery, and bodily aperture encounters.

layers.title: Generative Grammars & Substrates
layers.question: Which formal code-to-form grammar or living substrate drives the geometry here?
layers.description: Nine domain grammar engines (primitive, mesh, pattern, L-system, graph, morphology, noise, reaction-diffusion, trajectory) plus substrates and biome layers.

layers.title: Sonic, Voice & Acoustic Architecture
layers.question: What sings, what stays silent, and how do acoustics and impacts feel on Quest 3?
layers.description: Quest-safe GDScript phoneme singing, 0.9 s gaze-settle silence discipline, rain/wind ambience, spatial interaction cues, and unified physical impact boom feedback.

layers.title: Embodiment, Surface Sync & Provenance
layers.question: What is verified on Desktop vs. Quest 3 VR vs. Web/Book, and what is still planned?
layers.description: Honest separation across Quest 3 VR, Desktop Godot, Three.js Lab Editor, and Book Editions — distinguishing planned drafts, probe receipts, and lived human encounters.

songBreadcrumbs.crate: You begin inside a fragile shipping crate — notice how thin the boundary is before stepping out onto the roof.
songBreadcrumbs.others: Four identical units arrived, yet only Model B wakes; agency begins as an anomaly among copies.
songBreadcrumbs.clock: The roof clock establishes that the tower was already running before you looked at it.
songBreadcrumbs.chapter_03_line_black_box: Join two separate points to create a live line; the relation stays active in space and opens the side door.
songBreadcrumbs.chapter_03_pairing_point_field: Move one endpoint and watch what updates immediately versus what stays unchanged.
songBreadcrumbs.chapter_03_do_not_cross_barrier: A line in space is not just geometry — as a barrier it redirects how a body is allowed to walk.
songBreadcrumbs.chapter_13_pick_up_cube: Compare stillness, linear translate, rotate, and scale side by side to see how simple motion codes trigger emotional reactions.
songBreadcrumbs.letters: Model B reads the roof letters and realizes the building's label does not match who she is.

desiringMachine.activates: Model B gaze-camera witness loop and first Inner Opera fragments
desiringMachine.couplesInto: Every downstream floor's photography, song breadcrumbs, and void.md journal

queerOperator.note: One unit wakes out of four identical crates — refusing interchangeable industrial sameness.

Point_Zero.bodyHook: Care Body boots with BodyCharge (movement drains charge; falls remain safe).
Point_Zero.note: Opening anchor of the Void Tower; world, opera, and void.md are active.

Point_Lines.plainBreadcrumb: Join two points to form a persistent line that unlocks the door; pull an endpoint away to test whether the relation stays live.

desiringMachine.activates: Measured line segments (1 m, 2 m, 4 m timber planks) and 1:1 Space Ruler
desiringMachine.couplesInto: Point_Trace (comparing endpoints against journeys) and bridge building below

queerOperator.note: A straight line between two points is simultaneously a mathematical relation, a ruler, a door latch, and a police barricade.

Point_Lines.bodyHook: Walk shortened from 211.6 m to 62.8 m; ceiling laser tests BodyCharge impact feedback.
Point_Lines.note: Round 3 pilot anchor with Codex and Claude: sync live pull-away perturbation receipt, first song take, and void.md.

queerObservations.observation: RESET erases the wall's measurement while the opened doorway persists — proving the architecture remembers an act differently than the readout does.

Point_Trace.plainBreadcrumb: Two curved paths can share the exact same start and end points — the Trace grid in Shaft A keeps the bend that a straight line erases.

desiringMachine.machine: Trace Pen, Spray Cans & Shaft A Replay Grid
desiringMachine.activates: Gesture recording (20/80/200 mm spray pitch, 40 mm snapped beads, glass ink)
desiringMachine.couplesInto: Later trajectory grammars and witness disagreement on Floor 203

queerOperator.note: Same gesture read as continuous ink, quantized 40 mm spheres, or a replayed Shaft A trajectory — exposing what quantization discards.

Point_Trace.bodyHook: Hand Canvas tracks fingertip movement directly onto spatial residue.
Point_Trace.note: Paired with Point_Lines for the Ghost Student two-stop transfer proof.

queerObservations.observation: Two journeys with identical endpoints stay distinct in Shaft A's grid — refusing to collapse lived detour into a start-to-end summary.

Primitives_Melencolia.plainBreadcrumb: Simple geometric primitives assemble into domestic furniture and cultural forms — geometry is never detached from craft and labor.

desiringMachine.activates: Modular furniture composition from basic blocks and BoxLibrary inventory
desiringMachine.couplesInto: Transformation chapter below (where assembled objects begin to move)

queerOperator.note: Refuses to keep Platonic solids purely abstract; re-couples them into chairs, stools, and domestic assemblages.

Primitives_Melencolia.bodyHook: Walkable SE craft bay promenade clear of BoxLibrary.
Primitives_Melencolia.note: Reorganized as the clean capstone of Primitives before Transformation begins on F13.

Trans_Pre.plainBreadcrumb: Five linear passes (Static -> Translate -> Rotate -> Scale -> Archetype) show how standardized motion libraries code what we approach, avoid, or open — before color even exists.

desiringMachine.machine: Random-Loot Monochrome Packages & Active Linear Bombs
desiringMachine.activates: 10 random domestic/play objects (brick, dice, bowling pin, tin can, doorstop, gem...) that can be grabbed and thrown to detonate Bombs
desiringMachine.couplesInto: All Transformation floors (F14-F21) and unified global Boom/Flash/Shake/Blink impact feedback

queerOperator.note: Alan Warburton's Fairytales of Motion (2019): exposes how cartoon motion codes hardened into mocap, gait analysis, and AI behavioral profiling — and lets random domestic objects shatter standardized bomb threats.

Trans_Pre.bodyHook: Elevated monochrome Coin & Package scaffolds + sunken Shaft A Bomb Basin; full-screen flash, camera trauma / XR haptics, and blinking charge bar on impact.
Trans_Pre.note: Completed Round 3 same-family controlled comparison (10/10 PASS: STATIC/TRANSLATE/ROTATE/SCALE/ARCHETYPE orthogonal isolation across t=0/0.6/1.2s) + wrote commons/maps/Trans_Pre/void.md + verified live Dual Breadcrumb HUD on F13.

queerObservations.observation: Isolating static, linear translate, rotate, and uniform scale in pure monochrome strips cartoon invitation and threat down to three lines of arithmetic — while letting random domestic debris shatter standardized bombs.

Trans_Introduction.plainBreadcrumb: On F13 objects moved while rooms stayed still; here the architecture itself translates across Shaft B, rotates at center, and scales inside Shaft A to build one 37 m crossing.

desiringMachine.activates: Architectural translation, pivot plank, and scaling elevator descent into Shaft A
desiringMachine.couplesInto: F15-F18 dedicated Translation, Rotation, Carousel, and Scale halls

Trans_Introduction.bodyHook: Monochrome Coins trace the 37 m elevated crossing; riding scale lowers you physically to F15.
Trans_Introduction.note: Consolidated from 3 competing mechanisms into one monumental span with gallery work lights and curatorial monolith.

queerObservations.observation: Moving the BANK control leaves architecture displaced after the hand leaves — space itself keeps the mark of an intervention until reset.

Trans_Translation.plainBreadcrumb: Every point shifts by the exact same offset without turning or resizing — compare X/Y/Z axis cubes below and linear-motion mortar targets on the mirrored upper mezzanines.

Trans_Translation.bodyHook: Upper-deck mortar throwing exercises bodily arc estimation and unified boom feedback.
Trans_Translation.note: Cleared stray pyramid blockers, fixed colliding floor sign, upgraded mortar mines to monochrome linear lerp.

Trans_Rotation.plainBreadcrumb: Every turn requires a pivot and an axis — compare Y platform, Z upright lift, X Ferris wheel hanging into F17, and ten barriers arranged around one circumference.

desiringMachine.activates: Tangential speed comparison plus optional monochrome package-and-bomb timing range
desiringMachine.couplesInto: Orbital and rotational mechanics in Vectors and WaveFunctions

Trans_Scale.plainBreadcrumb: Growing a deck differs from unfolding fixed leaves, and transform order matters (T*R*S != S*R*T) — one 4x4 matrix holds all three together.

desiringMachine.machine: Scale Span Comparison, Order Matters Study & Transformation Workbench
desiringMachine.activates: Live shear, invariants, 3x3/4x4 matrix composition, and Drink Me scale chamber
desiringMachine.couplesInto: F19 body-scaling blocks and F21 growing square crossing

queerOperator.note: Non-commutative order (T*R*S != S*R*T) breaks the myth that formal operations are interchangeable — sequence determines where bodies end up.

Trans_Scale.bodyHook: South Drink Me chamber alters perceived bodily scale directly.
Trans_Scale.note: Re-spaced all 8 North Matrix Gallery stations clear of pillars/shafts, fixed backwards film_scale_children monitor, added 4 work lights.

queerObservations.observation: TSR and TRS apply the exact same operations yet strand the figure in two different poses — exposing how formal order encodes irreversible difference.

Trans_Body.plainBreadcrumb: Walk through three architectural membranes: elastic slats close again, blocks recover their size, and the third lattice permanently remembers the cut of your body.

desiringMachine.machine: Approach Slats, Approach Scale Blocks & Permanent Carve Grid
desiringMachine.activates: Body-driven reversible vs. irreversible spatial memory
desiringMachine.couplesInto: F20 Moving Boundary airlock and F118 Menger body-scale affordance

queerOperator.note: Architecture refuses to stay indifferent — the third lattice permanently preserves the non-standard silhouette of the body that passed through.

Trans_Body.bodyHook: Model B's literal body dimensions carve and displace all three membranes.
Trans_Body.note: Moved film_body_aperture into clear East-facing view across Shaft A; added gallery lights, monolith, and spine coins.

Trans_Pit.plainBreadcrumb: Slide an opening, widen its scale, combine all three in the airlock — and watch collection itself open a gate in the East portal bay.

desiringMachine.machine: Moving Boundary Doorways, Transformation Airlock, Pickup Gate & Pusher Block

desiringMachine.couplesInto: F21 Serpent continuous composition and F22 Logic Event gates

Trans_Pit.bodyHook: Timing bodily transit through sliding/scaling gates plus West pusher throw range.
Trans_Pit.note: Fixed backwards film_door_routes monitor, added monolith, gallery lights, and West pusher practice bomb.

queerObservations.observation: Crossing depends on arriving inside a moving or widening window — geometry here is inseparable from bodily timing and pace.

Trans_Playground.plainBreadcrumb: Translate, rotate, and scale chain into one continuous 40-metre monochrome Serpent course — ride shuttles, clear the bomb with a random package or take the detour.

desiringMachine.machine: Construction Robot (Playground Maker), Vending Stations & Serpent Fork

queerOperator.note: Offers an explicit choice at the fork: disrupt the obstacle with an unexpected thrown object, or take the longer railed detour.

Trans_Playground.bodyHook: Full continuous locomotion + ride-and-throw + unified screen flash / shake / blinking charge bar on detonation.
Trans_Playground.note: Upgraded Serpent gift & bomb to monochrome with unified big 3D boom, added 4 gallery work lights and chapter-finale monolith.

Logic_Event.plainBreadcrumb: Give the rolling ball both supports, then remove just one — a physical arrangement makes a logical AND/OR condition directly observable.

desiringMachine.machine: Logic Lever Gate & Prefab Unlock Station
desiringMachine.activates: One of the first active completion-wired prefab unlocks in prefab_inventory.gd
desiringMachine.couplesInto: Array (F23) and conditional machines throughout the tower

queerOperator.note: Takes invisible boolean gates out of black-box code and exposes them as physical gaps a ball can fall through.

Logic_Event.bodyHook: Physical manipulation of supports tests prediction before release.

queerObservations.observation: A boolean AND condition stops hiding behind symbols: the first gap flatters an incomplete setup until the second gap exposes what was missing.

Pattern_Temple.plainBreadcrumb: Weaving drafts, repeats, and symmetry rules operate as formal code — and Model B can wear the resulting cloth directly on her body.

desiringMachine.activates: Wearable woven patterns and textile grammar exploration
desiringMachine.couplesInto: Assemblage_Same_Desire looms and Model B wardrobe surfaces

queerOperator.note: Reclaims weaving — historically gendered craft — as foundational computational grammar worn directly on the android body.

Pattern_Temple.bodyHook: StudioWardrobe active across Pattern floors (F36-F44); Quest 3 v22 live-tested.
Pattern_Temple.note: Pattern sequence verified on Desktop (38/38) and signed Quest 3 APK v22 (6/6).

WaveFunctions_Intro.plainBreadcrumb: Turn the wheel until the cube hits the mark going up, then predict when it hits the same height coming down — one reading hides two opposite directions.

desiringMachine.activates: Smooth harmonic motion (first place sine replaces linear lerp!)

queerOperator.note: Demonstrates why a single static measurement is ambiguous without direction and phase.

WaveFunctions_Intro.bodyHook: Manual wheel turning couples hand rotation to periodic vertical motion.

queerObservations.observation: A polygon stops being a flat diagram the instant it has to carry a body's weight; support is provisional and ends the moment you step off.

encounterBreadcrumbs.keeps_door: Reset the line, then walk through the door that stays open.
encounterBreadcrumbs.keeps_trace: Carry the black point from START to FINISH twice — first straight, then arching high — and compare both saved traces in Shaft A.
encounterBreadcrumbs.keeps_weight: Step onto the wooden square so it carries your body weight, then step off and notice the support ends immediately.
encounterBreadcrumbs.keeps_bank: Drag BANK right and let go to leave the turquoise landing displaced, then press RESET to pull it back.
encounterBreadcrumbs.keeps_order: Press TSR, then press TRS on the measuring board — the exact same three moves produce two different poses when order changes.
encounterBreadcrumbs.keeps_threshold: Wait for CROSS and walk through both the sliding doorway and the widening doorway — each opening exists only in a brief window of time.
encounterBreadcrumbs.keeps_supports: Lower only the near cube and release the ball to watch it fall at the second gap, then lower both cubes so it reaches and tips the paddle.
encounterBreadcrumbs.spine_e2b84c6599e8519381: Time your crossing around the linear-sweep bombs, or throw any random object from a package to detonate them from safety.
encounterBreadcrumbs.spine_ac8c3e195da697fa74: Open a monochrome gift package to drop a random ordinary object (brick, die, tin can, bowling pin) that can disrupt the pacing bombs.
